name: Knockgraney

attributes.attribute: near Knockainy and the town of Pallas Green
sister, twin, or double of Aine

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Knockgraney is an Irish mythological site. It is also called Cnoc Greine. The hill stands beside Knockainy, close to the village of Pallas Green. It is devoted to Grian. That name means sun. Grian comes across as the sister, twin, or double of the goddess Aine.

okr.objective: Knockgraney is the Irish hill devoted to the sun goddess Grian.
